# `gcp.alloydb.instance`

A managed alloydb cluster instance.

[alloydb](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | alloydb |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `alloydb.googleapis.com/Instance` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: pre_create (pre_create/alloydb_instance.go.tmpl) sends a SECONDARY instance to instances:createsecondary; pre_delete (pre_delete/alloydb_instance.go.tmpl) skips the DELETE for one and reports success. THE BOUNDED GAP: secondary instances are not supported here. A SECONDARY goes to the ordinary create, and deleting one gets Google's refusal rather than Terraform's pretend success. PRIMARY and READ_POOL take Terraform's path.
decoder (decoders/alloydb_instance.go.tmpl) puts back networkConfig.enablePublicIp and enableOutboundPublicIp when Google omits them, which it does for false. The reconciler now does the same for any configured zero value (gcprov.carryOmittedZero). custom_import only parses `terraform import`'s id.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 1200s |
